verdict.rationale: Docs confirm bring-your-own-key/provider support ('OpenClaw can use many LLM providers. Pick a provider, authenticate, then set the default model as provider/model'), satisfying the BYO-keys half of the story, but nothing in the evidence pack documents token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation. Missing for 10: usage/cost dashboards, per-model spend reporting, per-conversation token/cost breakdowns, any billing/analytics UI evidence.
